junkcleaner.message:
Inventory Junk Cleaner:

This feature helps keep your inventory clean by getting rid of unwanted items. It works by:
- Recycling and/or destroying weapons and traps in your backpack below the selected Power Level.
- Destroying ingredients in your backpack below the selected Star Rating (tier).

It will NOT affect:
- Ammo/Resources without a tier (Planks, Quartz, Coal, etc.)
- Items in storage or in other backpacks (e.g. Ventures backpack)

To protect your existing weapons and traps, the program will take a backpack snapshot on its first run on an account. It will only process new items that match your criteria.
